name: Rindou Kaoru
source:
A man in the prime of his life that is a member of the governmental paranormal event countermeasure agency (GPM).
His duty is to monitor Enchanté where the non-humans gather, but he personally likes to relax there.
He's a calm gentleman who is seen as a worldly wise man among the regular non-human customers.
He looks like the type who only does desk work, but he has some training for combat.
